ungVien.name: Working with Spring Framework_Làm việc với Spring Framework

chung.Syllabus Name: Working with Spring Framework_Làm việc với Spring Framework
chung.Learning-Teaching Method: Project based learning,Problem based learning,Active learning,In-class lecture
chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 145-minute final exam + 102,6h self-study
chung.Description:
Upon completion of this course students shoud:

1. Understand the followings:

• Basic concepts of Java FX to build Desktop Application

• Basics of Object-Relational Mapping (ORM) with JPA and how it simplifies database interactions.

• Spring Framework, Spring Boot, which provides a comprehensive ecosystem for building enterprise-level applications.

• Spring Framework's dependency injection, and web frameworks to build robust and scalable applications

2. Be able to:

• Use JPA ORM tool to map Java objects to database tables.

• Use Spring Framework's dependency injection, and web frameworks to build robust and scalable applications.

• Develop Cross-platform Desktop applications and support for user experience (UI & UX)

3. Be able to work in team and present group's results
chung.StudentTasks:
- Students must attend at least 80% of contact sessions in order to be accepted to the final examination.

- Student is responsible to do all assigned exercises given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time

- Use laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information
chung.Tools:
- Internet

- IntelliJ IDEA

- Platform : Java Development Kit 21

- Scene Builder 23
